name: SDIC Capital Co.,Ltd
summary: SDIC Capital Co.,Ltd engages in the securities, guarantee, trust, leasing, futures, and public fund businesses in China. The company offers wealth management and institutional, investment banking and investment, research, futures, asset management, international, private equity investment, and alternative investment services; guarantee and credit enhance, and fintech services; and asset servicing trust and charitable trust services. It also provides direct leasing, and sale and leaseback services; and future brokerage, risk management, transaction consulting, and international services.
